summary: Elong Power Holding Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K containing its Management's Discussion and Analysis and unaudited interim consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, plus a first-half 2026 results press release dated October 6, 2026, signed by CEO Xiaodan Liu. The review notes that in March 2026 the company divested its battery-manufacturing subsidiary and shifted to an asset-light energy-storage system integration model focused on overseas residential and C&I storage and China grid-side applications. This is a routine interim reporting filing, not a special-situation event; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated.
